description: Find published successful visa cases for one required subclass (500/600/485/820), with school, advisor, subject and inclusive age filters. Call list_visa_case_filters for valid values. Returns a compact page, public IDs and website links; call get_visa_case for details. No keyword search, courseCode filter, similarity ranking or cross-subclass search. Cases are examples, not approval probabilities or processing-time forecasts.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

subject.description: Exact subject value from list_visa_case_filters; do not translate it.

visaType.description: One visa subclass: 500, 600, 485 or 820. Offer cases are not supported.

name: search_visa_cases
title: Search successful visa cases
